name: tree-sitter-http
description: tree-sitter grammars for .http files and message/http wire messages, and for the form-encoded bodies they carry

scripts.generate: cd http && tree-sitter generate --abi 14 && cd ../http_message && tree-sitter generate --abi 14 && cd ../form_urlencoded && tree-sitter generate --abi 14
scripts.test: cd http && tree-sitter test && cd ../http_message && tree-sitter test && cd ../form_urlencoded && tree-sitter test
